purpose: Everything that should be in Project Intelligence, why, and where it goes — the consensus scope document for the director's review.

status_legend.filed: item_key in evidence in the sources
status_legend.key_unconfirmed: likely exists; no key in the sources read — not invented
status_legend.rides: covered by the named parent item; no separate key in evidence
status_legend.not_filed: a gap — proposed_item_key supplied in the record's naming style

entries.name: Operating code inside PI

entries.name: The ratification packet

entries.name: Standing audit

entries.name: Smart Notes file-to-live timed proof

entries.name: Match wiring into feed, spaces, and mail

entries.name: Membership + courses
entries.why: Membership with its one activation gate, and the courses that hang from it

entries.name: Projects: world view + project view

entries.name: Growth, one master app
entries.why: Growth as one master app (survivor /rooms/growth), not a brand scattered across surfaces
